title: Montenegro 1943 - Mountain Stream - 20c Italian Occupation Issue Postage Stamp
descriptionText: The product is a 20c Italian Occupation Issue postage stamp from Montenegro, specifically from the period of 1941-1950. This stamp belongs to the mail aerea category and is of used quality, ungraded grade. It is an unc territories, specifically Italy, making it a valuable piece of European philatelic history.
